claims.claim: Final fixed-validation localization accuracy is 48.75% within 5 Search pixels (39/80).
The fixed-validation catastrophic-error rate above 25 pixels is 51.25% (41/80).
All seven fixed-validation exact-wallpaper cases localize within 5 pixels after the direct Search-centre convention.
The shipped delta=0.10 candidate pool has 90.0% recall within 5 pixels.
The seed-2026 randomized 40-pair evaluation reaches 55.0% within 5 pixels (22/40), 85.0% candidate recall, and 45.0% catastrophic errors.
Fixed-validation inference runtime is 2.86 s median, 6.15 s mean, and 30.32 s P95 per pair.
claims.qualification: Candidate computation through final selection; synthetic generation and result writing excluded.

claims.claim: The true site is a raw local maximum within 5 pixels in 100% of fixed-validation cases; the raw global maximum is correct in 38.75%, and median true-site rank is 4.
The pinned external reference-style generator reaches 93.33% on 120 development pairs and 100.0% on 30 untouched confirmation pairs.
